title: Battle of Leuze
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Leuze", at revision 1370447544, opens: "The Battle of Leuze was a large Cavalry engagement of the Nine Years' War that took place on 18 September 1691 between a detachment of French and a superior Allied force." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q608608, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1691 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
